walkers.grant_success: Successfully changed %s to be the second shape of %s.
walkers.switchShape_human_success: %s is now using the first shape.
walkers.switchShape_success: Set the current shape of %s to %s.
walkers.unlock_entity_blacklisted: This Entity is not available for you.
walkers.feature_not_available: This feature was overwritten by an addon.
walkers.variants_menu_guide: Cycle variants by scrolling, select with '%s'
walkers.legend.ability.desc: This morph has an ability you trigger yourself with %s. Hover the badge on a card to see what it does. A cooldown shows at the bottom right after using it.
walkers.legend.effect_good.desc: A green badge with a potion effect icon: you always have that effect (for example Night Vision as a bat).
walkers.legend.effect_bad.desc: A red badge with a potion effect icon: you always suffer from that effect.
walkers.trait.flying.desc: You can fly like in creative mode.
walkers.trait.climb_blocks.desc: You can climb up walls by walking into them.
walkers.trait.slow_falling.desc: You fall slowly and take no fall damage.
walkers.trait.stand_on_fluid.desc: You can walk on top of a fluid, such as lava for a strider.
walkers.trait.walk_on_powder_snow.desc: You can walk on powder snow without sinking.
walkers.trait.invulnerability.desc: You can't be hurt by most damage.
walkers.trait.no_physics.desc: You fly through walls and blocks, like a vex.
walkers.trait.undrownable.desc: You never run out of air.
walkers.trait.reinforcements.desc: Nearby mobs of your kind help you fight back when you're attacked.
walkers.trait.feared.desc: Some mobs run away from you, like creepers from a cat.
walkers.trait.burn_in_daylight.desc: You catch fire in the sun unless you wear a helmet or stand in water or shade.
walkers.trait.burn_in_moonlight.desc: You catch fire under the night sky.
walkers.trait.cant_swim.desc: You can't swim up and sink to the bottom of water.
walkers.trait.prey.desc: Some mobs hunt you, like foxes hunting chickens.
walkers.trait.cant_interact.desc: You can't interact with some mobs, for example to trade or breed.
One kind of damage kills you instantly. Hover the badge on a card to see which.
walkers.trait.temperature.desc_cold: You take damage in biomes too warm for snow.
walkers.trait.temperature.desc_warm: You take damage in biomes too cold for rain.
walkers.trait.temperature.desc_legend: You take damage in biomes that are too warm (or too cold) for you, like a snow golem in the desert.
walkers.trait.aquatic.desc: You breathe underwater, but suffocate on land.
walkers.trait.aquatic.desc_amphibious: You breathe both on land and underwater.
walkers.trait.nocturnal.desc: You sleep during the day instead of at night.
walkers.trait.rider.desc: You can ride certain mobs, like a skeleton riding a spider.
walkers.ability.anger.desc: Turn angry or calm. Nearby mobs of your kind join in.
walkers.ability.eat_grass.desc: Eat the grass below you to fill your hunger.
walkers.ability.evoker.desc: Summon evoker fangs. Sneak to summon vexes instead.
walkers.ability.get_item.desc: Get a few items, such as arrows for a skeleton.
walkers.ability.goat.desc: Charge forward and ram what's in front of you.
walkers.ability.guardian.desc: Fire a beam that hurts mobs in front of you while you're in water.
walkers.ability.llama.desc: Spit at what you're looking at.
walkers.ability.pufferfish.desc: Puff up to poison mobs that touch you, or deflate again.
walkers.ability.rabbit.desc: Eat from a carrot crop you're standing in.
walkers.ability.raid.desc: Start or extend a raid where you stand.
walkers.ability.random_teleportation.des: Teleport to a random spot nearby.
walkers.ability.sheep.desc: Shear yourself while holding shears, otherwise eat grass.
walkers.ability.shoot_fireball.desc: Shoot a fireball where you're looking.
walkers.ability.shulker.desc: Fire a homing bullet at the nearest mob. It makes the target levitate.
walkers.ability.sniffer.desc: Dig in the dirt below you for ancient seeds.
walkers.ability.teleportation.desc: Teleport to the block you're looking at.
walkers.ability.turtle.desc: Lay turtle eggs where you stand.
walkers.ability.warden.desc: Fire a sonic boom that goes through armor.
